Metadata.title: Seedreign
Metadata.titleDefault: Seedreign · Take the world before it collapses
Metadata.description: A free .io strategy game. One new world every dawn, the same seed for every player, gone by nightfall. Runs in your browser in 7 to 25 minutes.
Metadata.keywords: io game, strategy game, territory conquest, daily game, browser game, free to play, roguelike, multiplayer

Footer.tagline: One world a day, the same seed for every player, gone by nightfall.

Hero.subtitle: Territory strategy. A fresh procedural world every day. Share your result.
Hero.note: Free. No download, no account, one tap.

WhatIsIt.title: Four things make it Seedreign
WhatIsIt.description: One world. One seed. Everybody plays the same map, and by nightfall it is gone.

daily.title: A new world at dawn
daily.body: One seed sows the map, and it is the same map for every player on the planet. Nobody draws an easier world than you did.

skill.title: Taken on skill
skill.body: Territory, timing, your commander's abilities and whatever you dare grab off the map. Cards are one layer of seven, never the whole game.

living.title: The map fights back
living.body: Rivers flood, faults tear the land open, vaults crack. Then the Collapse eats the edges and forces the last fight.

share.title: Then you post the grid
share.body: Every run ends in a spoiler free grid of your world. Drop it in the group chat and let everyone compare the same day.

HowToPlay.title: Dawn to dusk in five steps
HowToPlay.description: No download, no lobby, nobody to wait for. You pick your orders, you take ground, and the world spends the rest of the day trying to take it back.

draft.title: Draft your orders
draft.body: The day opens with six order cards, the same six for every player alive. Take three and live with them.

expand.title: Take ground
expand.body: One slider splits your army between the push and the line. Territory feeds population, population feeds the next push, and a river held early is worth twice the troops.

pulse.title: Ride the World Pulses
pulse.body: Rivers burst, faults tear the land open, a vault cracks somewhere far away. The seed fires the same Pulse at the same second for everyone, so the only difference is what you do with it.

collapse.title: Survive the Collapse
collapse.body: At dusk the world unravels from the edges and the ground you can stand on shrinks. Whoever is still holding something when it stops gets the last fight.

share.title: Post the grid, climb the league
share.body: Score, ghost comparisons and a spoiler free grid of your world. Drop it in the group chat, then watch the day's percentile land in your weekly league.

World.title: Put a hand on the map
World.description: One number sowed this world, and it is the same world every time it loads. March your Seeded across it, spend an order, and watch the ground change hands under you.
World.help: Pick any ground and your Seeded marches there, taking every tile on the way. Arm an order first and the same pick spends the order instead. Arrow keys walk the map, Enter commits, Escape puts the card back.
World.note: Same engine, same hexes, the same one seed for everyone. A full day adds rivals on the other side of that border, a World Pulse every few minutes, and the Collapse closing in on a clock.

Modes.title: Six ways to take a world
Modes.description: The daily world is the ritual. Everything around it is where you warm up, climb, and build worlds of your own.

daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.body: One world, one seed, one shot at it. Draft, conquer, beat the day's condition and land on the same board as everybody else. 7 to 25 minutes.

blitz.title: Blitz
blitz.body: A random world and a short fuse. The whole arc, first border to Collapse, in the time it takes to wait for a bus.

ranked.title: Ranked
ranked.body: Bronze to Legend on a curated pool that rotates every Era. New theme, new cards, soft reset, and rewards that reach past the halfway mark.

weekly.title: Weekly Events
weekly.body: Decrees stack and the difficulty climbs a level at a time. Go as deep as you can hold on, and keep the rewards for every level you clear.

forge.title: The Forge
forge.body: Pick a seed, a size and the Decrees, then hand your friends the code. Same world, same rules, no excuses.

bots.title: Skirmish
bots.body: Three bot difficulties, whatever Decrees you feel like, no clock and no leaderboard. Where the openings get learned.

band.title: Worlds die. Your legend does not.
band.body: A world lasts a day. The streak, the league place and the collection you built on it carry into every world after, and none of it is for sale.

ritual.title: A daily ritual
ritual.body: One world a day, the same map for the whole planet, gone by nightfall.

streak.title: Streaks
streak.body: Show up at dawn and the count grows. Miss one and it starts again at one.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.body: Every daily result stacks into a weekly league and a place in the Era.

collection.title: Collection
collection.body: Cards, relics, banners and territory colours the whole map can see.

fair.title: Never pay to win
fair.body: Daily and Ranked deal everyone the same pool. Money buys looks, never power.

Share.title: Everyone played today's world. Post yours.
Share.description: A run ends in a grid nobody can be spoiled by, a place on today's board, and a percentile that follows you all the way into the Era.

result.label: World {world}
result.note: Colours and shape only. Nobody sees the route you took.

board.title: Then you find out where that put you
board.body: One seed for the whole planet means one honest ranking. Every daily percentile stacks into the weekly league, and the league into your place in the Era.

Faq.title: Straight answers
Faq.description: Everything people ask before their first world, answered without the marketing voice.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: Yes. The whole game, every mode, every day. Cosmetics and the Era Pass are the only things that cost anything, and neither one wins you a world.

install.question: Do I need to install anything?
install.answer: No. It runs in the browser tab you already have open. You can add it to your home screen if you want it a tap away, but that is a shortcut, not a download.

fair.question: Is it pay to win?
fair.answer: No, and it is built so it cannot become one. Daily and Ranked deal every player the same pool from the day's seed, never from your collection, and no card has a level or a stat you can buy.

mobile.question: Does it work on my phone?
mobile.answer: It was designed for a phone first: portrait, one thumb, and light enough to run on hardware that is a few years old. On a desktop it is the same game with more room.

length.question: How long does a world take?
length.answer: Between 7 and 25 minutes, and it ends whether you are ready or not. The Collapse closes the map in, so nothing drags.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: Not to play. You need one to keep a streak, hold a league place and carry a collection between worlds, and it takes a moment to make.

FinalCta.title: Take it before the Collapse does
FinalCta.description: Same map, same seed, same shot at it as everyone else on the board. When the world unravels, whatever you are still holding is the score.
FinalCta.note: Free. No download, no account, one tap.
